Remaining candidates are bread and pizza. I need a question that gets a different answer for each.

Of the options, "Is it soft?" fits bread (yes) and pizza (not really), though that's ambiguous. "Is it round?" fits pizza (yes) and bread (a loaf is often not round), also ambiguous. "Is it flat?" fits pizza (yes) and bread (no), which is a bit clearer. Pizza is usually round and flat, while bread is typically a loaf, so "flat" is the better choice.
